items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: I was able to play with the George Lewis band for a few weeks in 1957

ctx.x: we could sure check that out because I remember that I remember hearing the record and I think it was on their own label I still have the books in which I kept all sort of an inventory book that I kept I kept a list of everything in the record shop on the different labels and probably have that one listed

and then back out to San Francisco I played for a short while with the Turk Murphy band and then he went on the road for a long period and I had a I had by the time I had a wife and a fairly newborn child and so I wanted to put down a root so I did I stayed there and worked in the record business wholesale records luckily jazz records so I could do a meaningful job in selling that kind of material I was able to play with the George Lewis band for a few weeks in 1957 as I recall his trumpet player at the time was…
